inventory_loss_cents.interval: NONE. Rule 8: intervals only on the correct cluster unit (UTC day). This population is 12 windows, below the 5-complete-day floor, so a POINT ESTIMATE AND NO INTERVAL -- and that is said, not omitted
inventory_loss_cents.ruling_provenance: coordinator ruling, DE59 2026-09-04: (C') -- store the mark, its AGE and the gap flag; report held-forward as primary and the gap refusal as a second view

ruling_texts.A_held_forward_always: take the mark whatever its age. Never NOT_AVAILABLE after the window's first quote -- and marks the residual at a price the market may have left, SILENTLY, since the value does not say how old it is
ruling_texts.B_refuse_when_window_ended_in_gap: NOT_AVAILABLE, COUNTED, when the window's end falls in a gap or tick-change interval (`wf.touched(last_quote_t, WINDOW_S)`). Refuses to value the residual exactly where the residual is riskiest -- the gap is WHEN the position became dangerous

inventory_loss_cents.summed_terminal_net_shares_status: REPORTING-ONLY, CARRIES NO DECISION MEANING -- it is a share count across windows with different marks
inventory_loss_cents.terminal_indexes: WINDOW_S -- THE WINDOW'S END. NOT any generation's `t1`: the residual is a WINDOW-level object, a position left at window end, and `t1` is a generation field in this codebase. Ruled DE59; stated here so the next reader does not re-derive it
inventory_loss_cents.unit: per-slug; the sum of per-slug values is well defined, a cross-window net share position is not

latency_x_cost_sensitivity.reason: needs the 9-rung latency axis; one rung run

maker_pnl_cents.equals: post_fill_markout_cents -- the markout is struck from level and already contains the entry edge, so the two are one quantity and their SUM would double-count it

maker_pnl_reconciliation.predicate: |replay| <= |reference| -- the replay's received fills are a SUBSET of the reference's tranches once a policy cancels, so its markout cannot exceed the reference's in magnitude
maker_pnl_reconciliation.why_not_equality: equality would only hold for an arm that cancels nothing; asserting it would make the check fail on every acting arm

HEADLINE_per_stratum_sign.why_this_is_the_headline: NO STRATUM EVER MATCHED EXACTLY, and P4 requires equality on ALL strata SIMULTANEOUSLY. That is the universal fact. Control-over per stratum is NOT universal and must not be reported as though it were

MECHANISM_TEST_gap_vs_suppression.if_failed: a failure is the MORE IMPORTANT result: it would mean the all-positive sign is a repeated observation without the mechanism that licenses reading it as structural
MECHANISM_TEST_gap_vs_suppression.power_note: with few strata this statistic is weak; UNDECIDABLE is reported rather than resolved
MECHANISM_TEST_gap_vs_suppression.prediction: strata with a HIGHER suppression rate show a LARGER control-over gap
MECHANISM_TEST_gap_vs_suppression.statistic: Spearman on ranks -- the prediction is MONOTONE, not linear
MECHANISM_TEST_gap_vs_suppression.why: a random draw does not reproduce the treated arm's suppression clustering, so the control realises a systematically higher fraction of above events

aggregate_observations.extrapolation_required_to_bracket: target 333, observed minimum 412, observed range 111 wide -- bracketing needs a draw about 0.7 range-widths below the smallest of 60. Not absurd; not established.
aggregate_observations.what_the_count_supports: 0 of 60 draws at or below the target bounds the PER-DRAW probability at ~5.0% (rule of three, one-sided 95%). That is a statement about DRAWS, not about the achievable SET, and it is not exclusion.

p4_summary.conditional_on: the draw rule, the stratification, and the frozen protocol's single matched quantity. Without this field a reader inherits 'no matched floor exists' when what was shown is 'no matched floor exists UNDER THIS DRAW'
p4_summary.honest_limit: even a clean answer evidences UNREACHABLE FOR THIS CONSTRUCTION, never NEVER
p4_summary.what_licenses_the_strong_reading: the MECHANISM, not the count: a random draw does not reproduce the treated arm's suppression clustering, so the control realises a systematically higher fraction of above events. Under that mechanism an all-positive sign is CONFIRMATION OF A PREDICTED SIGN and the count is corroboration, not the argument

cancellation_economics.decides_nothing: REPORTED. Whether the trade-off is worth taking is the policy layer's (rule 14).
cancellation_economics.identity: net_pnl_delta == adverse_saved - spread_forgone (COMPUTED per arm, never asserted)
cancellation_economics.predicate: an arm pays SPREAD FORGONE on the fills it declines and is paid ADVERSE SAVED on the same fills; cancelling adds value iff saved > forgone
cancellation_economics.scope_and_limits: THE FILLS LEG ONLY, valued at t + MARKOUT_S over n=12 windows of 2026-09-04T13:35:14Z. It EXCLUDES the residual position at window end (`inventory_loss_cents`, unruled) and any value of avoiding a fill whose harm lands beyond the markout horizon. DEVELOPMENT EVIDENCE, not a validation: one coin, one latency rung, no forward day, no interval -- 12 windows is below the 5-complete-day cluster floor, so a POINT ESTIMATE AND NO INTERVAL (rule 8).

residual_policy_effect.why_this_is_emitted_regardless: it is read off the terminal net BEFORE any P&L, so it characterises the policy independently of what the inventory leg turns out to be

CONDVALUE_X_SKEW.why_both: the whole-book ratio is a ratio of two totals of which one is carried by the top 1%. The ex-tail ratio is what the other 99% of the book actually faces

cancel_mechanics.random_cancel_definition: a cancel that lands on a generation drawn without regard to its fills removes `fills_per_generation` fills at the book's mean P&L per fill. It is the null a cents_per_cancel must beat, and it is COMPUTED from this book, not assumed

tail_decline.reading_is_the_callers: counts and nets are REPORTED; whether an arm's tail behaviour makes the overlay case is the policy layer's (rule 14)

tail_and_cascade.why_these_three_together: the tail says WHERE the book's P&L lives, `r` says what an overlay must beat and what the body already exceeds, and the cascade says whether a cancel's cost is the ranker's PICK or the number of fills the picked generation held. Separately each invites a wrong reading; together they are the specification
